review:
Alien Fruits 3 moves the series to cluster pays: five or more connected symbols form a win. Unpredictable spin modifiers can trigger in the base game, and the bonus is called Cosmo Frenzy.

In Cosmo Frenzy, a progress bar tracks points, and each of five levels needs a set number of points and carries its own multiplier: 2x, 4x, 6x, 8x and 10x. All five spin modifiers are assured at each level. Chance x2 doubles the chance of triggering the bonus, and a bonus buy is available where permitted. Unusually for the series, BGaming rates this one medium-high volatility, with a 10,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive roughly once every 196 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
